shared_elements: carved stone monument in the round with a figural subject
face/head with prominent bulging round eyes
raised relief modelling of facial features
justification: Both are three-dimensional stone monuments depicting an anthropomorphic being with a frontal face whose large round eyes bulge outward, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A shows only a crudely blocked-out head/torso with almost no detail and no accompanying motifs, while B shows a fully elaborated standing figure covered in dense, intricate low-relief regalia — headdress, pectoral mask, belt ornaments and subsidiary faces — arranged in registers down the column, an entirely different level and manner of depiction.
